title: The Workout tab reads every workout ever saved just to count them, each time the tab opens
what: Every time the Workout tab comes into view, the 'only on this phone' card fetches the id of every workout on the phone to count them, even for members who are signed in and will never see the card. On a phone with years of workouts this is small wasted work on the busiest screen.
expected: The card asks the phone for a count only, and skips the read for signed-in members.
fix_line: Count workouts with one counting question, and skip it when the member is signed in

items.reason: phone app logic only; no panel web pages here (pagespeed.json covers the panel and websites)
